description: Prototype Masonry Buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Fatih Bahadir, Necmettin Erbakan University (erbakan.edu.tr). Acceleration data of the test specimens were measured with ADXL345 accelerometers. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-6ypr-q603. Keywords: Shaking Table, Failure Mechanism, Masonry buildings, Pig story acceleration, Energy Flux, Bond type. Published 2019-06-07. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-PDDL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
